quizName:
Sign Test
									  					
									  														  					Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: A diamond-shaped sign means:
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs warn drivers about hazards or special conditions ahead. They are usually yellow or orange.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
Traffic in the lane must turn in the direction of the arrow.
Lanes are reserved for buses and vehicles with a driver and one or more passengers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved for people with disabled parking permits.

questions.question: This sign indicates a:
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings warn drivers about hazards ahead. Round signs are used only to warn about railroad crossings.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead turns sharply right and then sharply left.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a pedestrian crossing. Watch for people entering the crosswalk or crossing in front of you. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a divided highway begins ahead.

questions.question: This sign tells a driver that:
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a flagger ahead. Always follow the flagger's directions. Flaggers wear orange or yellow vests or bright jackets. They use paddles and flags to direct traffic through the work zone.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Regulation signs control traffic speed and movement. This sign means left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: A flashing yellow light at an intersection means you should:

options.text: Slow down and proceed with caution.
Come to a complete stop as quickly as possible.
Stop and proceed only when the intersection is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and proceed with caution.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means slow down and proceed with caution. You do not need to stop completely.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A series of curves is ahead.
The road will be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road will be slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road is especially slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: If you see this sign, what should you do?

options.text: May pass a slow-moving vehicle if you can do so quickly.
May pass if you know the road ahead.
May pass, but only at night.

questions.explanation: This is a regulatory sign. It is white and rectangular with black markings. Drivers must obey all regulatory signs. This sign means you cannot pass other vehicles.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a divided highway is starting ahead. Stay to the right of the divider or median.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about road conditions or hazards ahead. This sign warns you that an intersection is coming so you can prepare to turn or handle traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign show?

options.text: The distance from road surface to a bridge or overpass.
The maximum legal height of a vehicle allowed in this state.
The maximum width of a vehicle allowed on the highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The distance from road surface to a bridge or overpass.
questions.explanation: This is a low clearance warning sign. It shows how much space is between the road and the bottom of a bridge or overpass (in this case, 12 feet, 6 inches).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a triangular yellow sign with black lettering that means no passing zone. It appears on the left side of two-way, two-lane roads where you cannot pass other vehicles.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare you for road hazards ahead. This sign tells you to watch for traffic coming from a side road.

questions.question: When you see this sign, you should stop and:

options.text: Check only the direction you plan to go, then proceed.
Let all vehicles that arrive before or after you go first.
Check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, you must come to a complete stop. Look in all directions for traffic before you proceed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.
Drive with caution and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop and wait for vehicles and pedestrians to clear before proceeding.

questions.question: This is a ____ sign.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign is a Yield sign. Slow down and check for traffic. Let pedestrians and oncoming vehicles go first. Stop only if necessary.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that the road becomes slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: This sign warns you that ahead is:
questions.explanation: A round sign means a railroad crossing is ahead. This sign is posted a few hundred feet before the tracks. Drivers should slow down, look, listen, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: This sign shows one type of:
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a T-shaped intersection is coming.

questions.question: What does this speed limit sign mean?

options.text: You must drive at exactly this speed.
The fastest you can legally drive here is 55 mph.
You must drive at this speed through the intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: The fastest you can legally drive here is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This is a speed limit sign. It shows the highest speed allowed on this road. When conditions are bad (rain, snow, ice), you may need to drive slower than the posted limit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is an object on the road.
Traffic is coming from the right.
The road curves sharply to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves sharply to the left.
questions.explanation: Chevron signs show sharp curves in the direction the arrow points. In this case, the road turns sharply left. You may see several chevron signs through a curve.

questions.question: When you see this sign, you should:

options.text: Be ready for traffic merging in from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready for traffic merging in from the right.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns that traffic may merge into your lane from the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn either right or left.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must turn either right or left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells drivers the road splits. You must choose to go either right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. Drive carefully on slippery roads.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare drivers for upcoming hazards. This sign warns of an intersection coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A sharp right turn is coming.
The road has many curves ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road has many curves ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead has many curves and turns.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you about the road ahead?

options.text: It turns sharply right, then left.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road curves to the right, then curves to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic is moving in both directions on the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Keep to the side shown by the arrow.
You may drive in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep to the side shown by the arrow.
questions.explanation: This is a "Keep right" sign. It tells you that an island, median, or barrier is ahead. You must drive to the right of it.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road curves right ahead. Slow down to the safe speed shown.
Divided highway begins. Slow down to the safe speed shown.
Merge. Slow down to the safe speed shown.
Winding road ahead. Slow down to the safe speed shown.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right ahead. Slow down to the safe speed shown.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road curves to the right. You should slow down to the safe speed shown (in this case, 35 mph).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This three-sided sign warns you to slow down at the intersection ahead. Be ready to stop and let other drivers or pedestrians go first. You can go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that parking is not allowed at this location. You must follow all rules shown on regulation signs.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This regulatory sign tells you that you must drive only in the direction shown by the arrow.

questions.question: From top to bottom, what is the correct order for traffic lights?
questions.explanation: On a vertical traffic light, red is always at the top and green at the bottom. On a horizontal light, red is always on the left and green on the right.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Be ready for traffic to merge into your lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready for traffic to merge into your lane.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you that traffic will be entering your lane from the right. Be prepared to allow them to merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange diamond-shaped signs mark construction and maintenance work areas. They help drivers and pedestrians stay safe. Fines for traffic violations may be doubled in these areas.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars on the right move first.
Let cross traffic pass before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let cross traffic pass before proceeding.
questions.explanation: At this sign, you must yield. Slow down and let other vehicles and pedestrians pass before you go. Stop if you need to.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to stop.
You must come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: A stop sign is eight-sided. You must come to a complete stop at this sign. Do not go until the intersection is clear and safe.

questions.question: The driver's left arm and hand point downward. What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When a driver's left arm points downward, they are signaling that they will stop. Be ready to slow down or stop if you are following this driver.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a crossroad is coming up ahead.

questions.question: This white sign means you should not pass other vehicles:

options.text: Until after you pass the sign.
Unless it seems safe to do so.

questions.explanation: A white rectangular sign is a rule you must follow. This sign means do not pass other vehicles at all.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash means something is not allowed. You cannot make a U-turn where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An eight-sided red sign means stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What does this warning sign tell you about?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to something coming up. This sign warns you about a curve to the right.

questions.question: A driver's left arm and hand are extended upward. What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When a driver's left arm and hand point upward, the driver is signaling a right turn. Change your driving if you are following this vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks are permitted on an upcoming narrow bridge.
The bridge ahead is open to one-way traffic only.
The bridge ahead is wide enough for only one car at a time.
The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that an upcoming bridge may be too narrow to safely meet or pass a truck. Be careful.

questions.question: What type of sign has this shape and color?
questions.explanation: Downward-pointing triangle signs mean you must yield. Slow down to a safe speed and stop if needed. Stop at a marked stop line if one exists.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Lane reduction. The right lane ends soon and traffic should merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane reduction. The right lane ends soon and traffic should merge left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that one lane will end soon and traffic must merge to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No left turn can be made here.
A left turn can be made only after stopping.
All traffic must turn right at the next intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: No left turn can be made here.
questions.explanation: A red circle with a diagonal line over a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign means left turns are prohibited.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs mean you must stop and give the right-of-way to other traffic. You may go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
Two lanes of traffic moving in opposite directions are about to merge.

questions.correctAnswerText: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the overpass ahead has limited height. Do not proceed if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.

questions.explanation: This sign prohibits right turns. You cannot turn right at an intersection displaying this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a yield sign is coming. Start to slow down when you see this warning.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a divided highway is starting ahead. The road will split into two separate one-way roads with a median between them. Stay in the right lane.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed where the sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic light is coming up.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right then sharply left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign shows that the road will curve sharply to the right and then sharply to the left.

questions.question: When you see this sign, you:

options.text: Are approaching a railroad crossing and should prepare to stop.
Will always stop at the upcoming railroad crossing.
Should stop and wait for a signal before crossing the railroad tracks.

questions.correctAnswerText: Are approaching a railroad crossing and should prepare to stop.
questions.explanation: This sign means a railroad crossing is coming. Look and listen carefully. Slow down and be ready to stop. Wait for any trains to pass before you drive across.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a four-way intersection is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round sign always means a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and do not use your brakes.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign indicate?

options.text: There is a steep hill ahead.
No trucks are allowed on the upcoming hill.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a steep hill ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns drivers that a steep hill is coming. Slow down and be ready to control your speed to protect your brakes.

questions.question: What does this road sign indicate?

options.text: The maximum safe speed for a residential area.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway entrance.
The maximum safe speed for a work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
questions.explanation: This advisory speed sign shows the maximum safe speed for exiting a highway. In this example, the safe exit speed is 30 mph.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that an intersection is coming. Look carefully for traffic crossing from other directions.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that U-turns are not allowed in this area. Traffic law signs must be obeyed.

questions.question: At a school crossing sign, you should:

options.text: Always stop, whether there is a stop sign or not.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always honk your horn when you see children.
Be ready to help children cross the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Always let pedestrians cross safely. Pay attention when driving through intersections or turning, especially near children.

questions.question: This symbol is used for:
questions.explanation: A bright orange triangle on the back of a vehicle shows it moves slowly. You may see this on farm equipment, roadwork vehicles, or horse-drawn wagons. It looks like a solid orange triangle during the day and a hollow red triangle at night.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns you to drive carefully when the road is wet and slippery.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: The road curves left, then right.
The road curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road curves to the right and then to the left. Slow down so you can safely drive through these curves.

questions.question: The posted speed limit shows:

options.text: The exact speed you must drive to avoid a ticket.
The maximum safe speed under good road and weather conditions.
The maximum safe speed under all conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed under good road and weather conditions.
questions.explanation: Speed limit signs show the highest legal speed for that road. You may need to drive slower than the limit when conditions are poor, such as rain or fog.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that a sharp turn is coming and you should reduce your speed.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Slow down when the road is wet.
The road has a series of curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down when the road is wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that pavement becomes slippery when wet. In wet weather, drive slower, avoid sudden braking or turns, and increase your distance from the car ahead.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign shows that pedestrians cross at this location.

questions.question: What can you do from the center lane?
questions.explanation: This lane is only for left turns from either direction. You cannot use it to pass other cars or drive straight through.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic is merging from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is merging from the right.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about dangers ahead. This sign means traffic will merge onto your road from the right. Be ready to let them in safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a side road is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a stop sign is coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black markings. They warn about dangers ahead. This sign tells you the road becomes slippery when wet. Drive slowly and carefully because your vehicle may be hard to control.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep downhill section is coming up.

questions.question: This sign warns about one type of:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign means your road ends at an intersection ahead. Slow down and get ready to stop or turn left or right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows that you cannot turn in the direction of the arrow. In this case, right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to dangers ahead. This sign warns you about a winding road with many curves coming up.

questions.question: What does this black and yellow sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is one-way only.
There is a detour to the right due to roadwork.
Slow down because the road turns sharply ahead.
There is a side road to your right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down because the road turns sharply ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead makes a sharp turn (in this case, to the right). Slow down before you reach the turn, just like you would at an intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow and black warning signs alert drivers to upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign tells you a lane is ending. Be ready to let other traffic merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.
There are a series of curves ahead.
The road may be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: There are a series of curves ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead has three or more curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits U-turns. Do not make a U-turn where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to slow down.
Do not drive in this lane.
You must come to a complete stop and yield the right-of-way.
Slow down, be prepared to stop, and, if necessary, yield the right-of-way.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, be prepared to stop, and, if necessary, yield the right-of-way.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign means you must yield. Slow down as you approach the intersection and be ready to stop. Let other vehicles, bicyclists, and pedestrians pass before you go.

questions.question: At a school crossing sign, you should:

options.text: Always stop, whether there is a stop sign or not.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always sound your horn when you see children.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Five-sided signs mean you are near a school zone or school crossing. Watch carefully for children and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually diamond-shaped with yellow backgrounds and black markings. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign tells you the divided highway is ending.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs communicate traffic laws. You must obey them. This sign means you cannot turn right at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits left turns.

questions.question: What does this yellow warning sign mean?

options.text: You are approaching a school or school crosswalk.
Slow down, drive with caution, and watch for children.

questions.explanation: This sign is posted on roads near schools to warn drivers to slow down, drive carefully, and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A five-sided yellow or yellow-green sign warns you of a school zone or school crossing.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are entering a one-way street in the wrong direction.
You can proceed if the road is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are entering a one-way street in the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: If you pass this sign, you are driving the wrong way. You could have a head-on collision. Turn around carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A lane ends or the road narrows ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A lane ends or the road narrows ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They alert drivers to upcoming hazards. This sign warns that a lane is ending or the road is getting narrower.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that the right lane is ending. Drivers in that lane need to merge into another lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs control how traffic moves and what drivers must do. This sign shows the direction you must drive on a one-way street.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They alert drivers to upcoming hazards. This sign warns that you are approaching a divided highway.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs prepare drivers for upcoming road conditions and hazards. They are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns of a steep hill ahead. Slow down to avoid brake damage or crashes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that bicycles may be in the area.

questions.question: When you see this black and yellow sign, it means:

options.text: The road to the right is one-way only.
There is a detour to the right due to road work.
The road ahead turns sharply at a steep angle.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply at a steep angle.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert you to conditions right ahead. This sign tells you to slow down for a sharp change in direction.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs alert drivers to upcoming conditions that may not be obvious. They are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns of a steep hill ahead. Adjust your speed to avoid crashes and brake damage.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a school crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a sharp right turn is coming.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: All traffic must go straight ahead.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A road joins from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that an intersection is ahead. A road will join from the right side.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a roundabout is coming. Enter slowly and let traffic already in the roundabout go first.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic may merge into your lane ahead.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and let trains pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let trains pass.
questions.explanation: This sign shows a railroad crossing is ahead. Slow down when you approach railroad tracks. Trains cannot stop for cars, so you must wait for them to pass before crossing the tracks.

questions.question: If you see this sign above your lane, you:

options.text: May continue through the interchange or exit from your current lane.
May stay in your lane and continue through the interchange.
Must exit the freeway if you stay in your current lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must exit the freeway if you stay in your current lane.
questions.explanation: An "Exit only" sign means that lane leads only to an exit ramp. If you stay in that lane, you will exit the freeway. You can change lanes to stay on the freeway.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep downgrade is coming. Check your brakes before going down.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: This sign shows a bicycle crossing or path. Drive carefully in this area because bicycles frequently cross or ride beside traffic here.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red and white triangular sign means you must yield the right-of-way to other traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to areas where bicycles, people, or animals are likely to cross the road.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is only for vehicles with a certain number of people in them.
You can only turn from certain lanes.
Drivers in both lanes must merge safely.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is only for vehicles with a certain number of people in them.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane. Only buses and cars with multiple passengers can use this lane.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Turn right after you come to a complete stop.

questions.explanation: This is a regulatory sign that shows laws you must obey. Right turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Circular signs warn drivers about railroad crossings. This sign tells you a train crossing is ahead. Watch for trains.

questions.question: At an intersection with a yield sign, what should you do?

options.text: Always stop before entering the intersection.
Only yield to traffic on the right.
Only yield to traffic on the left.
Slow down and let other traffic go first.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let other traffic go first.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means you must slow down and let traffic in the intersection or on the road you are entering go first.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are going the wrong way on a one-way street.
Do not drive in this lane.
When turning left on a green light, you must let oncoming traffic go first.

questions.correctAnswerText: When turning left on a green light, you must let oncoming traffic go first.
questions.explanation: This sign works with a traffic light to tell drivers that people turning left do not have the right-of-way. They must wait for oncoming traffic to pass.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Where this sign is posted, you cannot turn right. It is unsafe and against the law.
